verdict.rationale: Vercel's own CLI documentation says it can 'replicate your deployment environment locally', and the docs separately mention managing variables for a 'local' environment. That is a first-party claim toward local development that mirrors production, but it is a single thin mention with no detail on emulating the runtime (Functions, Fluid compute, middleware) or on how closely local behaviour matches production. missing for 10: a documented local dev server or emulator command, details on parity with the production runtime (functions, middleware, edge behaviour), local testing workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime

citations.quote: Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
